description: Daglo is the speech AI brand of ActionPower Corp., a Seoul-based company that develops its own Korean-language speech recognition models. The Daglo API offers synchronous, asynchronous and real-time (gRPC) speech-to-text with speaker diarization, keyword boosting and sentiment analysis, alongside summarisation, chat-completion and text-to-speech APIs, priced in KRW.
name: Daglo (ActionPower)
